name: Pipe Spear
hint: A long stick and a short blade have been flirting in your pack for a while. Help them commit.
text: You lash the blade to the end of the haft and wrap it until it stops wobbling. Mostly stops.

name: Nail Bat
hint: Something blunt, something pointy, something sticky. You've seen this movie.
text: You drive the sharp bits through and tape over the backs so they stay put. It's hideous. It's perfect.

name: Hammered-In Nails
hint: You have nails, a hammer, and something that would be improved by both. Do the math.
text: You hammer every nail in the box through the business end. The neighbors would have complained. There are no neighbors.

name: Barbed Wrap
hint: That coil of barbed wire wants to be wrapped around something you swing. Wear gloves. You don't have gloves.
text: You coil the barbed wire around it, tight, and only bleed a normal amount.

name: Live Wiring
hint: Batteries plus wire plus a blunt instrument equals a felony in at least eleven states. There are no states.
text: You run the wire from the batteries to the striking end. It hums. You don't touch the striking end.

name: Taped Grip
hint: Your weapon is slippery and you have tape. This isn't a riddle.
text: You wrap the handle tight. It sticks to your hand now, which is the idea.

name: Glass Shiv
hint: Broken glass is just a knife that hasn't been taped yet.
text: You pick the biggest shard and wrap one end until you can hold it without bleeding. Much.

name: Padlock in a Sock
hint: Something you can put things in, and something heavy. You know what you're doing.
text: You drop the heavy thing in and tie it off. Every parking lot in America, distilled.

name: Inner-Tube Sling
hint: Something stretchy and something that holds a rock. David had less.
text: You knot the stretchy part to the pouch and test it on a wall. The wall loses.

name: Garage Bola
hint: A cord with a heavy thing on each end. Throw it at legs.
text: You tie a weight to each end of the cord and whirl it once. It nearly takes your ear off. Good sign.

name: Caltrop Pouch
hint: A bag full of pointy things is a gift you give the floor.
text: You fill it with every sharp thing you can spare. Shake it. It sounds like a bad day for someone.

name: Trip Wire
hint: Wire at ankle height, staked with something sharp. Things that run at you will stop running.
text: You rig a length of wire with two anchors. It's invisible if you squint. They won't be squinting.

name: Molotov
hint: Bottle, fuel, rag. The oldest recipe on this floor, and the most honest.
text: You fill the bottle, stuff the rag in, and set it upright very, very carefully.

name: Aerosol Torch
hint: Hairspray and a lighter. Every middle-school science teacher's nightmare.
text: You tape the lighter to the can. Point away from face. Point away from face.

name: Glue Trap
hint: Cardboard plus superglue: a flat, sticky argument nobody wins.
text: You smear the whole tube across the cardboard and immediately glue two fingers together. Worth it.

name: Magazine Armor
hint: Enough padding and tape and you're a very well-read tank.
text: You tape the padding around your torso in layers. You look like a recycling bin. A durable one.

name: Magazine Lining
hint: Your shirt could stop a knife if you stuffed it with something and taped it shut.
text: You stuff the padding under your top and tape it down. Crinkly. Protective. Crinkly.

name: Strapped Trash-Lid Shield
hint: A trash can lid is one strap away from being a shield.
text: You tape a strap across the back of the lid. Knight of the Garbage Table.

name: Duct-Tape Splint
hint: Rags and tape: the field medicine of people with no medicine.
text: You fold the rags into a pad and tape it down tight. Ready for the next wound, which is coming.
